text:
maria-ui: Heads-up: I'm proposing we regroup sidebar entries into 3 top sections: Build (Models, Datasets), Serve (Endpoints, Canary Rollouts), Observe (Logs, Metrics, Alerts). Goal: clearer mental model for new users. Major UX question: how should deep links into subpanes be represented so theyre easy to share?

derek: My 2c: prefer hierarchical paths (`/console/models/123/versions/4`) over query tabs. Cleaner for history and copy-paste. Query params ok for filters, but not for top-level subpages.

sophie-px: Agree with paths. Also think breadcrumb labels should be human-friendly: "Model overview" not just "Overview"; when someone lands on `/models/123/versions/4` the crumbs should be clickable and lead to stable pages. Small copy nit: avoid ambiguous labels like "Deploy"  maybe "Deployments" or "Endpoints" depending on resource.

ryan-eng: Implementation notes: route-based subpages mean more entries in our router table but we can generate them programmatically from the nav config. We should implement 301-style client redirects for incoming `?tab=` links to new path segments, but keep the original URL in telemetry. Also, avoid double fetch on redirect during SSR-heavy pages.

maria-ui: Accessibility stuff: when deep-linking to a subpage, ensure focus lands on the H1 and a live region announces "Navigated to X" only for assistive tech. Provide a visibly focusable "Skip to content" link for keyboard users. Also ensure the left nav uses `aria-expanded` states on groups.

derek: One tricky case: highlighting the left nav when a nested resource is active (e.g., versions inside models). Suggest a mapping table: canonicalRoute -> navParentKey so we can compute active state without string parsing.

sophie-px: Copy decision: we should standardize on singular resource labels in left nav (Model, Dataset) but plural in lists (Models, Datasets)  that helps breadcrumb grammar. Also replace any internal-use language like "master" with neutral terms.

nav-bot: NOTE: routing PR opened: `console/nav-paths` -> review requested. CI: lint + a11y checks.

ryan-eng: Performance note: client-side redirect from `?tab=` -> path should be guarded by server-side mapping when possible to return canonical links for crawlers and bots. Fallback to client redirect only when server mapping not available.

maria-ui: I'll hand off updated IA mockups showing the three sections and exact path examples. Follow-up will include a short a11y checklist and a copy sheet for breadcrumbs. Thanks everyone! :wave:
